name: Recall / retrieval
objective: Retrieve the right fact, definition, property, law or canonical result from a meaningful cue and distinguish it from nearby alternatives.
choose_when: After removing arithmetic and surface wording, the main difficulty is retrieving or recognizing the correct stored item.
do_not_choose_when: Do not use when the learner must mainly explain why, translate a representation, execute a procedure, choose a model, prove a result, or interpret evidence.

slots.X: the category, cue or wording that determines what must be retrieved
slots.Y: an organizing structure, contrast, hierarchy or demonstrated idea that can cue retrieval
slots.Z: a retrieval route that narrows to the relevant family without stating the requested item
slots.W: the requested fact, definition, property, law or result the learner must retrieve or recognize independently

hint_objectives.REPRESENTATION: Clarify what category or property the question is cueing, without naming the requested item.
hint_objectives.KEY_CONCEPT: Connect that cue to an organizing structure, contrast or pattern the learner already knows; do not rely on an isolated mnemonic alone.
hint_objectives.CRUX: Provide a retrieval route to the right family and leave the requested item itself to the learner.

figure_policy.job: Use a figure or table only when the retrieval target belongs to a meaningful structure, classification or spatial relation; decorative imagery is not evidence.

solution_architecture: state the result in the question's wording
